decisions.reason: PETG thermoforming blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming and materials know-how, so in-house R&D can interpret customer feedback and keep refining the product despite missing website evidence for 2020-2021.

The contrast spray supports the firm's digital scanning workflow strategy, but it sits further from its core materials base and has had no web presence since 2018, which raises the risk of withdrawal without yet justifying it.
Custom earmolds are a central competence of the hearing-care business, where skilled custom manufacturing and digital production let the firm absorb market feedback and improve the line continuously.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold manufacturing and digital production knowledge in an adjacent market, so the firm can assimilate the learning even though recent visibility is limited.
